ttl.name: Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly RH

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Inspect ELR Lock Starting Tilt Angle

s3.ptxt: When the retractor is moved slowly from its installed position, check that the belt does not lock within 15° in any direction, and that it remains locked at 45° or more.

s2.ptxt: Temporarily tighten the front seat outer belt assembly RH with the 2 bolts.
Connect the connector and lock the locking button.
Install the shoulder anchor of the front seat outer belt assembly RH with the nut.

atten4.ptxt: Install using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Center Pillar Garnish Lower LH

atten4.ptxt: Install using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly Floor Anchor

s2.ptxt: Install the floor anchor portion of the front seat outer belt assembly RH with the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Install Lap Belt Outer Anchor Cover

atten4.ptxt: Install using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip LH

s2.ptxt: Align the paint mark (yellow) on the weatherstrip with the arrow on the body side shown in the illustration, and install the rear door opening trim weatherstrip LH.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that the corners are not lifted.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Scuff Plate LH

atten4.ptxt: Install using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip LH

s2.ptxt: Align the paint mark (pink) of the weatherstrip with the arrow part on the body side shown in the illustration, and install the front door opening trim weatherstrip LH.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that the corners are not lifted.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 10 claws and install the front door scuff plate RH.
Check that the warning light comes on when the IG is turned ON.
Check that the warning light goes off approximately 6 seconds after the IG is turned ON.

item.ptxt: If the warning light remains on even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, there is a malfunction in the airbag/pretensioner system.

If the light comes on occasionally even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, a short to +B, short to ground or open circuit in the airbag warning light circuit may be the cause.
If the light comes on even with the IG OFF or ACC ON, a malfunction in the power supply system or combination meter assembly may be the cause.
